items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Karg-Elert was one of them. Andersen studies.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the books that you were using?

[Sigfrid] Karg-Elert was one of them. Andersen studies. There was one other book we had. I can’t remember it right now. But there were three. Karg-Elert, Andersen – no, I can’t remember the third one.
Did you ever encounter the Slonimsky?
